description: This file defines a static class 'Slug' with an extension method 'GenerateSlug' for generating URL-friendly slugs from strings. It uses regex for cleaning and formatting the input string to conform to slug standards.

classes.name: Slug
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for string manipulation related to URL slug generation.

methods.name: GenerateSlug
methods.description: Creates a URL-friendly slug from the input string by removing invalid characters, collapsing spaces, trimming length, and replacing spaces with hyphens.
